note: Baseline 2026-09-17 (installed wheel = HEAD bc42921, before A2.4): nodes 3/4, QUEUE_FLOWS 1/2 (0.50, PARTIAL). The packet spec expected a fully blind Kafka pair, but A2.2 (wave 4) already added the `@KafkaListener` row, so the kafkajs -> @KafkaListener half is green at baseline and stays here as a POSITIVE CONTROL. The half under test is Spring Cloud AWS `@SqsListener("refunds")`: CONSUMER_PATTERNS had no annotation row for it, so `queue_consumer:refunds` was XX and the SQS pair 0/1. A2.4 adds the annotation rows; the producer's queue URL and the listener's bare name both resolve to `refunds` (sqs family on both sides). Verified that wave through the working-tree CLI (`glia arch producer --with consumer` -> 2 QUEUE_FLOWS rows, channels orders + refunds; `[queues] resolver paired=2`); grade.py sees it only after the end-of-wave wheel rebuild.
